newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks end down, exporters hurt by higher yen.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks end down, exporters hurt by higher yen.

text.p: Tokyo stocks slipped on Tuesday afternoon, weighed on by damage to exporter issues from the yen's strength against the dollar, brokers said.
News that prosecutors had raided Dai-Ichi Kangyo Bank Ltd in a widening investigation into links between financial firms and racketeers also hurt sentiment, they said.
The Nikkei average fell 156.92 points or 0.77 percent to close at 20,332.83. Nikkei June futures fell 210 to 20,340.
"Currencies dented the indices, but the market is keen to see what happens at the U.S. Federal Open Market Committee meeting later today," said Yasuo Ueki at Nikko Securities.
